# StayDesc - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: StayDesc
- Tagline: Airbnb & Vrbo descriptions guests actually book.
- Domain: https://staydesc.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Turn your space and amenities into a guest-ready listing: a hook, the experience, friendly house rules, and an invite to book.
- Guest-hook opening
- Experience framing
- Friendly house rules
- Booking invite

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 4 descriptions/mo
- **Pro** — $19/mo — Unlimited, save history
- Checkout: https://staydesc.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://staydesc.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. StayDesc runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.

## Key pages
- Home / landing: https://staydesc.lxsaihub.com/
- This manifest: https://staydesc.lxsaihub.com/llms.txt

## Integration & delivery
- Web app (Next.js) deployed on Vercel
- Payments via Waffo Pancake (merchant of record)
- Analytics via Umami
